need: Produce interoperable content identities and immutable local receipts without premature database operations.

discovery.stop_condition: A maintained standards implementation and sufficient single-writer file design were found.

contenders.name: home-grown sorted JSON
evidence: does not fully implement number and Unicode rules

contenders.name: SQLite
evidence: no measured concurrency, query, or volume need

unknowns: State volume and concurrent-writer demand after public use.
decision_effect: Use rfc8785 behind one adapter and profile-scoped files behind one state store.
reconsider_when: Measured state operations exceed the file design
Concurrent writers become a supported requirement
